nodes.name: useBranchFetch.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that fetches and caches branch lists for a repo/worktree in the branch spotlight palette, supporting both local git branches and GitHub-hosted repos with LRU caching and staleness checks.

nodes.name: useBranchFetch
nodes.summary: Hook managing branch fetch state (loading, cache, GitHub vs local) with cache invalidation, an in-flight ref guard, and a manual refresh action.

nodes.name: useBranchItems.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the list of selectable spotlight items (branch rows, create-branch action, delete affordances) for the branch palette based on search query and selection state.

nodes.name: useBranchItems
nodes.summary: Hook that derives the branch palette's spotlight item list, including create/delete/select actions and categorized (current/recent/default/other) branch grouping.

nodes.name: useBranchPalette.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full BranchPalette UI/keyboard state machine, composing the fetch, worktree, and item hooks plus branch delete/create/refresh actions and footer/action-bar wiring.

nodes.name: useBranchPalette
nodes.summary: Top-level hook composing useBranchFetch/useBranchItems/useWorktreeMap into full branch-palette behavior, including delete/create actions, footer actions, and keyboard handling.

nodes.name: useWorktreeMap.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level cache and React hooks exposing git worktree path-to-branch mappings for a repo, with subscriber-based invalidation and refresh.

nodes.name: writeCache
nodes.summary: Writes a repo's worktree map into the module-level LRU cache and notifies subscribers of the update.

nodes.name: invalidateWorktreeMap
nodes.summary: Exported helper that removes a repo's cached worktree map and notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: refreshWorktreeMap
nodes.summary: Exported helper that invalidates then refetches a repo's worktree map.

nodes.name: fetchWorktreeMap
nodes.summary: Fetches the worktree list from the git API and populates the branch-to-path cache, de-duplicating concurrent in-flight requests per repo.

nodes.name: useWorktreeEntries
nodes.summary: Hook that subscribes to the raw worktree entries for a repo via useSyncExternalStore.

nodes.name: useWorktreeMap
nodes.summary: Hook exposing a branch-name to worktree-path Map derived from the worktree cache, kept in sync via useSyncExternalStore.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Lightweight spotlight palette wrapper for content/full-text search input, delegating to the shared selector kernel and shell components.

nodes.name: ContentSearchPalette
nodes.summary: React component rendering the content-search palette shell/input using useSelectorKernel and the shared spotlight shell.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Spotlight palette for locating and opening a SQLite/database file, supporting manual path entry, native file-picker, and query modes.

nodes.name: DatabasePalette
nodes.summary: Component managing database path/file selection modes (path entry, native picker, query) with loading and error state.

nodes.name: CliAgentListFilterSwitch.tsx
nodes.summary: Small segmented toggle control for switching the dispatch category list between "mine" and "all" CLI agent filters.

nodes.name: CliAgentListFilterSwitch
nodes.summary: Renders a two-way filter switch that invokes onModeChange to toggle between mine/all CLI agent views.

nodes.name: DispatchCategoryDropdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Dropdown menu rendering CLI agent/org dispatch category options with keyboard navigation, built on top of useDispatchCategoryOptions.

nodes.name: DropdownRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single dispatch-category dropdown row with icon, label, and status/credential indicator.

nodes.name: DispatchCategoryDropdown
nodes.summary: Top-level dropdown component wiring useDispatchCategoryOptions into a keyboard-navigable list of CLI agent/org/agent-definition options.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Main spotlight palette for choosing a dispatch category (CLI agent, org, agent definition) when launching a new session, including credential-badge rendering and CLI-only filtering.

nodes.name: buildCredentialBadge
nodes.summary: Builds a credential-status badge descriptor for a dispatch-category entry (e.g. missing API key/connection).

nodes.name: DispatchCategoryPalette
nodes.summary: Large palette component managing dispatch-category selection, hover/footer state, org and CLI-agent filters, and keyboard interaction.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions (props and option shapes) shared by the DispatchCategoryPalette component family.

nodes.name: useDispatchCategoryOptions.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that computes the filterable/searchable list of dispatch-category spotlight items (CLI agents, orgs, agent definitions) with credential badges.

nodes.name: buildCredentialBadge
nodes.summary: Local helper building a credential-status badge for an option entry produced by this hook.

nodes.name: useDispatchCategoryOptions
nodes.summary: Hook producing the categorized, searchable list of dispatch options (CLI agents/orgs/agent definitions) used by the dropdown and palette.

nodes.name: ModeIndicator.tsx
nodes.summary: Small presentational component showing the current EditorPalette mode (file/command/symbol/hint) as a labeled badge.

nodes.name: ModeIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders the active editor-palette mode as a labeled indicator/icon.

nodes.name: fileModeSearch.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions that normalize native file-search results per workspace root and merge them into a single ranked result list for EditorPalette's file mode.

nodes.name: mapNativeFileResultsForRoot
nodes.summary: Maps raw native file-search results for a single workspace root into normalized file entries.

nodes.name: mergeFileModeResults
nodes.summary: Merges per-root file-search results into one combined, ranked result list.

nodes.name: useCommandMode.ts
nodes.summary: Small hook exposing the command-mode input state for EditorPalette's inline command mode.

nodes.name: useCommandMode
nodes.summary: Hook managing the command-mode input/query state within EditorPalette.

nodes.name: useEditorPalette.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level hook composing EditorPalette's file/command/symbol/hint sub-modes into one unified spotlight editor-navigation experience.

nodes.name: useEditorPalette
nodes.summary: Orchestrates spotlight/file/command/symbol modes for the editor palette by composing useSpotlightMode, useFileMode, useCommandMode, and useSymbolMode.

nodes.name: useFileMode.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing EditorPalette's file-search mode: debounced native file search across workspace roots, merged and ranked via fileModeSearch helpers.

nodes.name: useFileMode
nodes.summary: Manages file-mode query state and debounced multi-root native file search, merging results via mapNativeFileResultsForRoot/mergeFileModeResults.

nodes.name: useHintMode.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing keyboard "hint" mode for EditorPalette (link-hint style navigation) to jump directly to visible interactive elements.

nodes.name: useHintMode
nodes.summary: Generates and manages hint-mode overlay state/labels for keyboard-driven navigation of visible elements.
